messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the Canadian public‑holiday long weekends that fell in 2023. (Long weekends are created when a statutory holiday falls on a weekday, giving you at least one extra day off.)

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **January 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | Weekend – no extra day |
| **February 20** (Monday) | Family Day (BC, AB, MB, ON, SK) | Long weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| **April 7** (Friday) | Good Friday | Long weekend (Fri–Sun) |
| **May 22** (Monday) | Victoria Day (all provinces) | Long weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| **July 1** (Saturday) | Canada Day | Weekend – no extra day |
| **September 4** (Monday) | Labour Day (all provinces) | Long weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| **October 9** (Monday) | Thanksgiving (all provinces) | Long weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| **November 11** (Wednesday) | Remembrance Day (all provinces) | Long weekend (Wed–Thu) |
| **December 25** (Monday) | Christmas Day | Long weekend (Sat–Mon) |

These are the statutory holidays that produced at least one “extra” day off in 2023. If you’re looking for provincial variations (e.g., Family Day isn’t observed in all provinces), let me know which province(s) you’re interested in and I can refine the list further.
